tools.name: browser_close
tools.title: Close browser
tools.description: Close the page

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.title: Resize browser window
tools.description: Resize the browser window

tools.name: browser_get_config
tools.title: Get config
tools.description: Get the final resolved config after merging CLI options, environment variables and config file.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.title: Get console messages
tools.description: Returns all console messages

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

all.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: File name to save the console messages to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, messages are returned as text.

tools.name: browser_cookie_list
tools.title: List cookies
tools.description: List all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)

tools.name: browser_cookie_get
tools.title: Get cookie
tools.description: Get a specific cookie by name

tools.name: browser_cookie_set
tools.title: Set cookie
tools.description: Set a cookie with optional flags (domain, path, expires, httpOnly, secure, sameSite)

httpOnly.description: Whether the cookie is HTTP only

tools.name: browser_cookie_delete
tools.title: Delete cookie
tools.description: Delete a specific cookie

tools.name: browser_cookie_clear
tools.title: Clear cookies
tools.description: Clear all cookies

tools.name: browser_resume
tools.title: Resume paused script execution
tools.description: Resume script execution after it was paused. When called with step set to true, execution will pause again before the next action.

step.description: When true, execution will pause again before the next action, allowing step-by-step debugging.

location.description: Pause execution at a specific <file>:<line>, e.g. "example.spec.ts:42".

tools.name: browser_highlight
tools.title: Highlight element
tools.description: Show a persistent highlight overlay around the element on the page.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

style.description: Additional inline CSS applied to the highlight overlay, e.g. "outline: 2px dashed red".

tools.name: browser_hide_highlight
tools.title: Hide element highlight
tools.description: Remove a highlight overlay previously added for the element.

element.description: Human-readable element description used when adding the highlight; must match the value passed to browser_highlight.

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tools.name: browser_annotate
tools.title: Annotate the current page
tools.description: Open the Playwright Dashboard in annotation mode for the current page and wait for the user to draw annotations. Returns the annotated screenshot, ARIA snapshot, and the list of annotations.

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.title: Handle a dialog
tools.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tools.name: browser_emulate_media
tools.title: Emulate media features
tools.description: Emulate CSS media features for the page, for example switch between the light and dark color scheme. Omitted parameters are left unchanged; null clears an override.

anyOf.description: Changes the CSS media type of the page

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate JavaScript
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

filename.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, result is returned as text.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.title: Upload files
tools.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tools.name: browser_drop
tools.title: Drop files or data onto an element
tools.description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element, as if dragged from outside the page. At least one of "paths" or "data" must be provided.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

paths.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

data.description: Data to drop, as a map of MIME type to string value (e.g. {"text/plain": "hello", "text/uri-list": "https://example.com"}).

tools.name: browser_find
tools.title: Find in page snapshot
tools.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

text.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

filename.description: Save results to a file instead of returning them in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.title: Fill form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.title: Press a key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tools.name: browser_type
tools.title: Type text
tools.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

tools.name: browser_mouse_move_xy
tools.title: Move mouse
tools.description: Move mouse to a given position

tools.name: browser_mouse_down
tools.title: Press mouse down
tools.description: Press mouse down

button.description: Button to press, defaults to left

tools.name: browser_mouse_up
tools.title: Press mouse up
tools.description: Press mouse up

button.description: Button to press, defaults to left

tools.name: browser_mouse_wheel
tools.title: Scroll mouse wheel
tools.description: Scroll mouse wheel

tools.name: browser_mouse_click_xy
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Click mouse button at a given position

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

delay.description: Time to wait between mouse down and mouse up in milliseconds, defaults to 0

tools.name: browser_mouse_drag_xy
tools.title: Drag mouse
tools.description: Drag left mouse button to a given position

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.title: Navigate to a URL
tools.description: Navigate to a URL

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.title: Go back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in the history

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.title: List network requests
tools.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details.

static.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

filter.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

filename.description: File name to save the network requests to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.title: Show network request details
tools.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

index.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

filename.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, output is returned as text.

tools.name: browser_network_state_set
tools.title: Set network state
tools.description: Sets the browser network state to online or offline. When offline, all network requests will fail.

state.description: Set to "offline" to simulate offline mode, "online" to restore network connectivity

tools.name: browser_pdf_save
tools.title: Save as PDF
tools.description: Save page as PDF

filename.description: File name to save the pdf to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the pdf is saved into the output directory as `page-{timestamp}.pdf`.

tools.name: browser_start_recording
tools.title: Start recording user actions
tools.description: Start recording actions that the user performs in the browser as Playwright code. Use it when the user wants to demonstrate a flow manually. Call browser_stop_recording when the user says they are done to retrieve the recorded actions.

tools.name: browser_stop_recording
tools.title: Stop recording user actions
tools.description: Stop the recording started with browser_start_recording and return the recorded actions as Playwright code.

tools.name: browser_route
tools.title: Mock network requests
tools.description: Set up a route to mock network requests matching a URL pattern

headers.description: Headers to add in "Name: Value" format

removeHeaders.description: Comma-separated list of header names to remove from request

tools.name: browser_route_list
tools.title: List network routes
tools.description: List all active network routes

tools.name: browser_unroute
tools.title: Remove network routes
tools.description: Remove network routes matching a pattern (or all routes if no pattern specified)

pattern.description: URL pattern to unroute (omit to remove all routes)

tools.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
tools.title: Run Playwright code (unsafe)
tools.description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from the specified file. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.title: Take a screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. If unset, inferred from the filename extension, otherwise png.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the screenshot is saved into the output directory as `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}`.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

scale.description: Image resolution scale. "css" produces a screenshot sized in CSS pixels (smaller, consistent across devices). "device" produces a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (larger, accounts for the device pixel ratio). Default is css.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.title: Page snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

filename.description: Save snapshot to a file instead of returning it in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

depth.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

boxes.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

tools.name: browser_click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.title: Drag mouse
tools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.title: Hover mouse
tools.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.title: Select option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tools.name: browser_generate_locator
tools.title: Create locator for element
tools.description: Generate locator for the given element to use in tests

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tools.name: browser_storage_state
tools.title: Save storage state
tools.description: Save storage state (cookies, local storage) to a file for later reuse

filename.description: File name to save the storage state to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the storage state is saved into the output directory as `storage-state-{timestamp}.json`.

tools.name: browser_set_storage_state
tools.title: Restore storage state
tools.description: Restore storage state (cookies, local storage) from a file. This clears existing cookies and local storage before restoring.

filename.description: Path to the storage state file to restore from. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.title: Manage tabs
tools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

url.description: URL to navigate to in the new tab, used for new.

tools.name: browser_start_tracing
tools.title: Start tracing
tools.description: Start trace recording

tools.name: browser_stop_tracing
tools.title: Stop tracing
tools.description: Stop trace recording

tools.name: browser_verify_element_visible
tools.title: Verify element visible
tools.description: Verify element is visible on the page

role.description: ROLE of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- {ROLE} "Accessible Name":`

accessibleName.description: ACCESSIBLE_NAME of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- role "{ACCESSIBLE_NAME}"`

tools.name: browser_verify_text_visible
tools.title: Verify text visible
tools.description: Verify text is visible on the page. Prefer browser_verify_element_visible if possible.

text.description: TEXT to verify. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- role "Accessible Name": {TEXT}` or like this: `- text: {TEXT}`

tools.name: browser_verify_list_visible
tools.title: Verify list visible
tools.description: Verify list is visible on the page

target.description: Exact target element reference that points to the list

tools.name: browser_verify_value
tools.title: Verify value
tools.description: Verify element value

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

value.description: Value to verify. For checkbox, use "true" or "false".

tools.name: browser_start_video
tools.title: Start video
tools.description: Start video recording

filename.description: File name to save the video to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the video is saved into the output directory as `video-{timestamp}.webm`.

fps.description: Video frame rate in frames per second, defaults to 25

cursor.description: Render an animated mouse cursor that travels to each action point. Paces actions by 800ms so that the cursor has time to travel.

tools.name: browser_stop_video
tools.title: Stop video
tools.description: Stop video recording

tools.name: browser_video_chapter
tools.title: Video chapter
tools.description: Add a chapter marker to the video recording. Shows a full-screen chapter card with blurred backdrop.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds to show the chapter card

tools.name: browser_video_show_actions
tools.title: Show action overlays
tools.description: Annotate subsequent actions performed on the page with a callout that names the action and, when styled, marks the action point and highlights the target element. Useful while video recording or screencasting.

duration.description: How long each action annotation stays on screen, in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.

position.description: Where to place the action title relative to the page. Defaults to top-right.

cursor.description: Cursor decoration for pointer actions. "pointer" (default) animates a mouse pointer from the previous action point to the next one; "none" disables the cursor decoration.

point.description: CSS declarations for the zero-sized marker centered on the action point, e.g. "width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: red". Not shown when omitted.

highlight.description: CSS declarations for the box that covers the target element, e.g. "outline: 2px solid #333". Not shown when omitted.

title.description: CSS declarations for the action title, e.g. "font-size: 16px".

tools.name: browser_video_hide_actions
tools.title: Hide action overlays
tools.description: Stop annotating actions performed on the page.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.title: Wait for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

time.description: The time to wait in seconds, at most 30

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

tools.name: browser_localstorage_list
tools.title: List localStorage
tools.description: List all localStorage key-value pairs

tools.name: browser_localstorage_get
tools.title: Get localStorage item
tools.description: Get a localStorage item by key

tools.name: browser_localstorage_set
tools.title: Set localStorage item
tools.description: Set a localStorage item

tools.name: browser_localstorage_delete
tools.title: Delete localStorage item
tools.description: Delete a localStorage item

tools.name: browser_localstorage_clear
tools.title: Clear localStorage
tools.description: Clear all localStorage

tools.name: browser_sessionstorage_list
tools.title: List sessionStorage
tools.description: List all sessionStorage key-value pairs

tools.name: browser_sessionstorage_get
tools.title: Get sessionStorage item
tools.description: Get a sessionStorage item by key

tools.name: browser_sessionstorage_set
tools.title: Set sessionStorage item
tools.description: Set a sessionStorage item

tools.name: browser_sessionstorage_delete
tools.title: Delete sessionStorage item
tools.description: Delete a sessionStorage item

tools.name: browser_sessionstorage_clear
tools.title: Clear sessionStorage
tools.description: Clear all sessionStorage
